title: Give safe actionable guidance when the launcher cannot locate its Git run directory
outcome: Give safe actionable guidance when the launcher cannot locate its Git run directory
acceptance: Launching where Git cannot locate the review-runs directory reports safe guidance to run from a repository worktree without copying raw Git stderr into normal completion output.
A public CLI regression verifies the safe guidance for a non-repository launch with no run directory.
disposal_reason: Fable ruling e07a4663: share the same launcher implementation file and one changeset; preserve both original criteria verbatim in the replacement bundle.
